book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Qasseka Yesusi, «Hekko hayssa wursa ta inttes intte ammanoy yark yarkofo gaada yootadis.
Istti inttena ba keeththafe gooddana; haray attoshin inttena wodhizaadey wuri Xoossas ooththizaade misatiza wodey yaana.
Istti hessaththo ooththizay tanakka, ta Aawaakka erontta gishshassa.
Ta hayssa inttes yootiza wode intte ta inttes gidayssa qoppanaassa» gides. Kaaleththidikka Yesusa, «Hayssa wursa ta inttes yootontta aggiday ta inttenara issife diza gishshassa.
Xillo Ayana Ooso
«Ha7i qasse tana kiittidayssako ta baana gays; gido attiin inttefe oonikka, ‹Ne awa baanee?› giidi oychchanay baa.
Gido attiin hayssa wursa ta inttes yootida gishshas intte wozinay muuzottees.
Ta qasse inttes tumu gays; ta buussi inttes go7a gidana; gaasoykka ta bontta aggiko minththeththiza Ayanay intteko yeenna; ta bidaappe guye iza intteko yeddana.
Izi yiidi asa nagara gishshassinne xilloteththa gishshas qasseka pirda gishshas erisana.
Asa nagara gishshas izi erisanay asay tana ammanontta gishshassa.
Xilloteththa gishshas izi asaa erisanay tani ta Aawaakko biza gishshassinne qasse nam7anththo intte tana be7ontta gishshassa.
Pirda gishshas izi erisanay hayssa alameza haarizayssa bolla pirdettida gishshassa.
«Ta inttes buro yootana daro yo7oy dees; gido attiin ha7i inttena deexxana.
Tuma Ayanay yiidi inttena tumay dizaso kaaleththana; gaasoykka izi siyidayssa yootana attiin baappe gidontta gishshas izi sinththafe hanana yo7ota inttes yootana.
Taas dizayssafe ekkidi izi inttes yootiza gishshas tana bonchchana.
Aawaas gididay wurikka tayssa, ‹Taas gididayssafe ekkidi izi inttes yootana› ta giday hessassa» gides.
Intte Muuzoteththi Ufayssan Laamettana
Yesusi gujjidi, «Guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyekketa; qasseka guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyana» gides.
Iza kaallizaytappe baggati ba giddon, « ‹Hayssi nuus guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyekketa; qasseka guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyana; qasse ta Aawaakko baana› guussi ay guussee?» gida.
«Histtiin hayssi, ‹Guuththa wodeppe guye› gizayssi izi aazee? izi yootizayssi nuus erettenna» giidi ba giddon zaari zaari oyshettida.

Istti iza oychchanayssa Yesusi eridi isttas, «Intte intte giddon issoy issaara oyshettizay ta inttes, ‹Guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyekketa; qasseka guuththa wodeppe guye intte tana beyana› gida gishshassee?
Ta inttes tuma gays; intte waassananne yeekkanashin alamey gidikko ufayettana. Intte muuzottishin intte muuzoy ufayssan laamettana.
Maccassi yelo wodey gakkishin miixas hirgawus; gido attiin naa yela yeggidaappe guye biitta bolla nay yelettida gishshas ufayssafe dendidayssan kase ba waaydayssa zaara qoppuku.
Hessaththo intteka ha7i muuzotteeta; qasse ta inttena beyana intte wozinaykka ufayettana; intte ufayssaa zaari ekkanaadey deenna.
«Intte he wode taappe aykkoka woosseketa; ta inttes tumu gays; ta sunththan ta aawaa woossiko izi inttes ubbaaka immana.
Hanno gakkanaas intte ta sunththan aykkoka woossi erekketa; woossite intte ekkana; intte ufayssayka kumeth gidana.
«Ha7i gakkanaas ta inttes leemisora yootadis; hayssafe guye ta leemisora yootontta wodey yaana. Gido attiin Aawaa gishshas ta inttes ubbaa qonccisa yootana.
He wode intte ta sunththan woossana; tanikka, ‹Aawaa intte gishshas woossana› giikke.
Gaasoykka Aaway ba baggara inttena dosiza gishshassa; Aaway inttena dosizay intte tana dosiza gishshassinne tani Xoossa achchafe yidayssa intte ammanida gishshassa.
Tani Aawaa achchafe kezada hayssa ha alame yadissinne qasseka ha alameza aggada Aawaakko simma baana» gides.
Iza kaallizayti, «Hekko ne ha7i leemiso gidontta nuus qonccera yootadasa.
Ne wursa eriza malanne oonikka nena oychchanaas koshshonttayssa ha7i nu eridos; hessa gishshas ne Xoossa achchafe kezidayssa nu ammanoos» gida.
Yesusi isttas, «Intte ha7i ammanideta;
gido attiin intte intte baggara baggara laalettidi tana xalla aggana wodey gakkides; he saateyakka ha7i gakkadus. Gido attiin Aaway tanara gidida gishshas ta tarkka diikke.
Ta hayssa inttes yootizay intte tanan de7iin inttes saroteththi daana mala gaada yootays. Intte ha alamen dishin inttes waayey dees; gido attiin aykkoy baa; ta alame xoonadis» gides.
